field.label: Rotation grace (days)
field.help: How long a device may keep using its old key after a rotation is requested. Expiry raises an alert — it never cuts access.

field.label: IP quarantine (days)
field.help: How long a released address stays unallocatable after a revocation. 0 disables the quarantine.

field.label: Device limit per user
field.help: Maximum non-revoked devices per user, enforced at enrollment. 0 means unlimited.

field.label: Audit retention (months)
field.help: Retention horizon for audit entries. Entries older than this are purged by the periodic maintenance job (every 15 minutes; the purge records itself in the journal). Keeping less than 12 months is discouraged: a revocation should stay traceable months later.

field.label: Site name
field.help: Name shown by the client apps for this site (e.g. the company name). Empty uses this firewall's hostname.

field.label: Control plane pin
field.help: SPKI SHA-256 pin (base64, 44 characters) of the certificate this web GUI presents to enrolled devices, which reach it through their tunnel. This is not the enrollment host certificate below — devices refuse the control plane unless this pin is set. Compute it with: openssl x509 -in cert.pem -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform der | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary | base64

field.label: Site key
field.help: Optional. Stored here and served to the client apps in the bundle each managed device receives, so nobody has to retype it. This plugin never reads, parses or validates this value — it carries it, and the client apps alone decide what it means. Leave empty if you have none: the apps work without one.

field.label: Enrollment host
field.help: Public host (host or host:port) devices reach to enroll; printed into every enrollment link and QR code. Token issuance refuses until this is set.

field.label: Certificate pin (optional)
field.help: SPKI SHA-256 pin (base64, 44 characters) of the enrollment host certificate. Only needed when the certificate is not publicly verifiable (internal CA, self-signed).

field.label: Listen on
field.help: Address and port the public enrollment endpoint listens on when the exposure is applied below (HAProxy frontend). 0.0.0.0:443 means every IPv4 address on the HTTPS port; the web GUI must not listen on that port.

field.label: Certificate
field.help: Server certificate the public endpoint presents (System > Trust > Certificates). Use one devices can verify — a public CA or ACME — or pin it in Enrollment links above.

field.label: Local API URL
field.help: The firewall's own API endpoint used to manage WireGuard peers and, when the exposure is applied, the HAProxy objects. Leave the default unless this firewall's web GUI listens elsewhere.

field.label: API key
field.help: Key of a local API user allowed to manage WireGuard — and HAProxy, if the public exposure is used. The plugin makes no other call and never leaves this firewall.

field.label: API secret
field.help: Secret of the API user above.

field.label: Verify TLS certificate
field.help: Verify the certificate on the local API call. Off by default: the loopback call presents this firewall's own (usually self-signed) certificate.
